install: export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"; export PATH="$DOTNET_ROOT:$PATH"; command -v dotnet >/dev/null && dotnet --list-sdks | grep -q '^10\.' || { curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh && bash /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 10.0 --install-dir "$DOTNET_ROOT"; }; cd "$PWD" && dotnet restore CofRules.slnx && dotnet test CofRules.slnx --nologo && mkdir -p data && dotnet run --project src/CofRules.Cli -- import --db data/cof_rules.db
